public class Main {
    static long[] st = new long[18];
    static long[] a = new long[18];
    static long[] b = new long[18];
    static long[] c = new long[18];
    static long fans = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static void check() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
            a[i] = c[i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 17; i++) {
            if (b[i] > 0) {
                a[i + 1]++;
                a[i] -= 10;
                a[0]--;
            }
        }
        if (a[0] < -6) {
            a[0] += 11;
            a[1]--;
        }
        if (a[0] > 6) {
            a[0] -= 11;
            a[1]++;
        }
        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
            total += Math.abs(a[i]) * (i + 1);
        }
        if (total < fans) {

    static void generate_combinations(int step) {

            check();
            return;
        }
        for (int val = 0; val < 2; val++) {
            b[step] = val;
            generate_combinations(step + 1);
        }
    }

        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        st[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 18; i++) {
            st[i] = st[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long current = n;
        int position = 17;
        while (current > 0) {
            c[position] = current / st[position];
            current %= st[position];
            position--;
        }
        generate_combinations(0);
        System.out.println(fans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
